title: ACS Condition on Minimal Isoparametric Hypersurfaces of Positive Ricci Curvature in Unit Spheres
summary: We study the Ambrozio--Carlotto--Sharp (ACS) criterion on minimal isoparametric hypersurfaces $N^{n+1}\subset S^{n+2}$ with positive Ricci curvature, motivated by the Schoen--Marques--Neves conjecture on Morse index.For $g=4$ distinct principal curvatures with multiplicities $m_1,m_2$, we prove that the pointwise ACS inequality holds if and only if $\min\{m_1,m_2\}\ge 4$.
